MR Safety
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Umbra Coronary Stent System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
· Static magnetic field of 1.5 and 3 Tesla
· a maximum spatial field gradient of 2,000 Gauss/cm
· At 1.5 T: Maximum MR system reported, whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 1.5 W/kg; Maximum active scan time of 30 minutes
· At 3 T: Maximum MR system reported, whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 0.5 W/kg
· Head Transmit/Receive Coil ONLY
· Receive with the head transmit/receive coil
· RF excitation: circularly polarized (CP) only
· Scan regions: Full body scanning is permitted (no exclusion zone)
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Umbra Coronary Stent System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 2.4 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
